summary: Completed comprehensive testing of async polling validation feature. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed - login, navigation, Nova Validação dialog with 3 dropzones, and validation list all working correctly.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (console warning)

passed_tests: Backend: Login with test@test.com/123456 works (200 OK)
Backend: POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa requires holerite_atual file (422 without)
Backend: GET /api/validacoes/job-status/{job_id} returns status and progress
Backend: Job completes successfully and returns result with validation ID
Frontend: Navigation to Validação Folha page works
Frontend: Nova Validação button opens dialog
Frontend: Dialog shows 3 dropzones (Holerite Atual, Holerite Mês Anterior, Arquivos de Apoio)
Frontend: Empresa, Mês, Ano selectors present
Frontend: Validation list shows items grouped by competência
Frontend: Polling logic implemented correctly (2 second interval)
critical_code_review_comments: Async polling implementation is correct - POST returns job_id, GET job-status returns progress
Frontend polling interval is 2 seconds as specified
Cleanup effect properly clears polling interval on component unmount
In-memory job storage (validation_jobs dict) works for single-instance deployment
Background task processing with asyncio.create_task() is properly implemented
seed_data_creation: Test validations created during testing with holerite files containing employee data (JOÃO DA SILVA, MARIA SANTOS, PEDRO OLIVEIRA)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async polling validation feature is fully working. Key features tested: 1) POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa returns job_id immediately and processes in background. 2) GET /api/validacoes/job-status/{job_id} returns status (processing/completed/failed), progress (0-100), step description, and result when completed. 3) Frontend polls every 2 seconds and updates UI with progress. 4) DELETE endpoints work for individual and batch deletion. 5) In-memory job storage (validation_jobs dict) is used - note this won't persist across server restarts.

async_polling_validation.description: Payroll validation with async polling to avoid UI blocking
endpoints: POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa - Returns job_id immediately, processes in background
GET /api/validacoes/job-status/{job_id} - Returns status, progress, step, result/error

architecture_notes.job_storage: In-memory dict (validation_jobs) - not persistent across restarts
architecture_notes.file_handling: Temporary files saved to /tmp/validacao_jobs/{job_id}/, cleaned up after processing
